h0: Independent frozen corpus replication yields aggregate metrics statistically indistinguishable from preregistered primary metric under declared test
h1: Independent frozen corpus replication yields aggregate metrics outside preregistered equivalence bounds for primary metric
mesi: Minimum effect size interest: 5 percentage-point shift in primary accounting invariant rate (if applicable) or Cohen's d=0.5 for continuous metrics
primary_metric: TBD at corpus freeze — must be declared before any outcome file is opened
statistical_test: Two-one-sided-tests (TOST) equivalence if bounds pre-specified; otherwise two-sample permutation test with 10,000 permutations
power_sample_size_rationale: Determined at corpus freeze based on available independent records; if N<30, use exact/permutation methods only
multiple_comparison_correction: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across secondary metrics if k>1

decision_tree.pass: Replication within equivalence bounds → REPLICATION_SUCCESS FCO
decision_tree.fail: Outside bounds → CONTRADICTION FCO linked to THESIS; do not suppress
decision_tree.indeterminate: Corpus not independent or N insufficient → REPLICATION_PREREGISTERED_NOT_EXECUTED

missing_data_policy: ABSTAIN per record with explicit reason; exclude from aggregate only via preregistered rule logged before inspection
corpus_freezing_procedure: Identify genuinely independent corpus source distinct from prescripted GAP/FCG demo paths
Snapshot bytes to experiments/EXP-005/inputs/ with SHA-256 manifest
Lock analysis plan JSON before opening any outcome CSV/JSON
source_acquisition_rule: Only sources with LOCAL_CUSTODY or IMPORTED terminal state in PAPER_SOURCE_MANIFEST.v2.jsonl
stopping_rule: Single pre-registered analysis pass; no optional peeking; sensitivities pre-listed only
sensitivity_analyses: Alternate isoform policy if sequence data involved
Stricter abstention threshold for GAP-like joins
failure_indeterminate_branch: If no independent corpus before deadline → emit REPLICATION_PREREGISTERED_NOT_EXECUTED; do not substitute retrospective corpus
